messages.content: {"query": "refund policy late delivery", "policy": "Refund Policy. A refund can be requested only for orders whose status is completed. Orders with status cancelled were never charged, so no refund applies to them. If a completed order is delivered in more than 45 minutes, the customer receives a full refund of the order amount. If a completed order is delivered in 45 minutes or less, no late-delivery refund is paid. Refunds up to INR 1000 are approved automatically by the support system. A refund above INR 1000 must be approved by a human support lead before money is returned. Approved refunds are credited to the original payment method within 5 working days. A refund request must be raised within 7 days of the delivery date.\n"}
